description_en: Queries scaling rules and their details by specifying parameters such as the scaling rule ID, scaling rule name, and unique identifier of the scaling rule. The details include the adjustment type, instance warmup time, and event-triggered tasks associated with the scaling rules
description_zh: 调用DescribeScalingRules并指定伸缩规则ID、伸缩规则名称、伸缩规则唯一标识符等参数，查询伸缩规则及其详细信息。例如，伸缩规则的调整方式、实例预热时间、伸缩规则关联的报警任务信息等
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-scaling-rules --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --scaling-group-id 'asg-bp1ffogfdauy0jw0****' --scaling-rule-type SimpleScalingRule --show-alarm-rules false --scaling-rule-ids '["asr-bp1dvirgwkoowxk7****"]' --scaling-rule-names '["scalingrule****"]' --scaling-rule-aris '["ari:acs:ess:cn-hangzhou:140692647406****:scalingrule/asr-bp1dvirgwkoowxk7****"]' --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeScalingRules

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group to which the scaling rules belong
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩规则所属伸缩组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the scaling rule list. Pages start from 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩规则列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The Settings for the number of entries per page during a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the scaling rule. Valid values: 

SimpleScalingRule: simple scaling rule. Adjusts the number of ECS instances based on the adjustment type (AdjustmentType) and adjustment value (AdjustmentValue).
TargetTrackingScalingRule: target tracking scaling rule. Dynamically calculates the number of ECS instances to scale out or scale-in based on a predefined metric (MetricName) and attempts to maintain the metric value near the target value (TargetValue).
StepScalingRule: step scaling rule. Provides a step-by-step extension method based on thresholds and metric values.
PredictiveScalingRule: predictive scaling rule. Analyzes the historical monitoring data of the scaling group based on machine learning capabilities to predict future monitoring metrics, and supports the automatic creation of scheduled tasks to set the boundaries of the scaling group
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩规则的类型。取值范围： 

SimpleScalingRule：简单规则。根据调整方式（AdjustmentType）和调整值（AdjustmentValue）调整ECS实例数量。
TargetTrackingScalingRule：目标追踪规则。根据预定义监控（MetricName）项动态计算需要扩缩容的ECS实例数量，尽量将预定义监控项的指标值维持在目标值（TargetValue）附近。
StepScalingRule：步进规则，根据阈值和指标值提供分步扩展方式。
PredictiveScalingRule：预测规则，基于机器学习能力分析伸缩组的历史监控数据预测未来监控指标值，并支持自动创建定时任务设置伸缩组边界
parameters.name: scaling_rule_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the CloudMonitor event-triggered tasks associated with the scaling rules. Valid values:

true: returns the CloudMonitor event-triggered tasks associated with the scaling rules.
false: does not return the CloudMonitor event-triggered tasks associated with the scaling rules.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回伸缩规则关联的云监控报警任务。取值范围：

true：返回伸缩规则关联的云监控报警任务。
false：不返回伸缩规则关联的云监控报警任务。

默认值：false

AdjustmentType.description_en:
The adjustment type of the scaling rule. Valid values:

QuantityChangeInCapacity: increases or decreases a specified number of ECS instances.
PercentChangeInCapacity: increases or decreases a specified percentage of ECS instances.
TotalCapacity: adjusts the number of ECS instances in the scaling group to a specified number
AdjustmentType.description_zh:
伸缩规则的调整方式。可能值：

QuantityChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定数量的ECS实例。
PercentChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定比例的ECS实例。
TotalCapacity： 将当前伸缩组的ECS实例数量调整到指定数量

AdjustmentValue.description_en: The adjustment value of the scaling rule

AlarmDimensions.description_en: The dimension value of the metric. This parameter applies to target tracking scaling rules and is configured when the metric requires additional dimension information. For example, the LoadBalancerRealServerAverageQps metric requires the rulePool dimension information
AlarmDimensions.description_zh: 监控项维度信息值，适用于目标追踪规则，当监控项需额外维度信息时设置，例如LoadBalancerRealServerAverageQps监控项需指定rulePool维度信息

DimensionKey.description_en: The key of the dimension associated with the metric

DimensionValue.description_zh: 监控项关联的维度信息值

Alarms.description_en: The CloudMonitor event-triggered tasks associated with the scaling rule. The associated CloudMonitor event-triggered tasks are returned only when the ShowAlarmRules parameter is set to true. Otherwise, an empty list is returned
Alarms.description_zh: 伸缩规则关联的云监控报警任务。仅在ShowAlarmRules参数为true时返回伸缩规则关联的云监控报警任务，否则返回空列表。

items.description_en: The CloudMonitor event-triggered tasks associated with the scaling rule. The associated CloudMonitor event-triggered tasks are returned only when the ShowAlarmRules parameter is set to true. Otherwise, an empty list is returned
items.description_zh: 伸缩规则关联的云监控报警任务。仅在ShowAlarmRules参数为true时返回伸缩规则关联的云监控报警任务，否则返回空列表。

AlarmTaskId.description_en: The ID of the event-triggered task associated with the scaling rule
AlarmTaskId.description_zh: 伸缩规则关联的报警任务的ID

AlarmTaskName.description_en: The name of the event-triggered task associated with the scaling rule
AlarmTaskName.description_zh: 伸缩规则关联的报警任务的名称

ComparisonOperator.description_en:
The comparison operator used to compare the statistical value of the metric with the threshold for the event-triggered task associated with the scaling rule. This operator specifies the relationship between the statistical value and the threshold that meets the condition. Valid values:

>=: the statistical value of the metric is greater than or equal to the threshold.
<=: the statistical value of the metric is less than or equal to the threshold.
>: the statistical value of the metric is greater than the threshold.
<: the statistical value of the metric is less than the threshold
ComparisonOperator.description_zh:
伸缩规则关联的报警任务使用的监控项统计值与阈值的比较符，用于指定监控项统计值与阈值在什么关系下满足条件。可能值：

监控项统计值大于等于阈值。取值：>=。
监控项统计值小于等于阈值。取值：<=。
监控项统计值大于阈值。取值：>。
监控项统计值小于阈值。取值：<

Dimensions.description_en: The dimension information of the event-triggered task associated with the scaling rule
Dimensions.description_zh: 伸缩规则关联的报警任务的维度信息

items.description_en: The dimension information of the event-triggered task associated with the scaling rule
items.description_zh: 伸缩规则关联的报警任务的维度信息

The key of the dimension associated with the metric. Valid values:

DimensionKey.description_zh:
监控项关联的维度信息键值。可能值：

DimensionValue.description_en: The value of the dimension associated with the metric
DimensionValue.description_zh: 监控项关联的维度信息属性值

EvaluationCount.description_en: The number of consecutive times the threshold expression must be met for the event-triggered task associated with the scaling rule to reach the alert state
EvaluationCount.description_zh: 伸缩规则关联的报警任务到达报警状态需要连续满足阈值表达式的次数

MetricName.description_en: The name of the metric for the event-triggered task associated with the scaling rule
MetricName.description_zh: 伸缩规则关联的报警任务监控项名称

MetricType.description_en:
The type of the event-triggered task associated with the scaling rule. Valid values:

system: system monitoring event-triggered task.
custom: custom monitoring event-triggered task

伸缩规则关联的报警任务的类型。可能值：

system：系统监控报警任务。
custom：自定义监控报警任务

Period.description_en: The period for collecting metric data in the target tracking scaling rule
Period.description_zh: 目标追踪规则中统计监控项数据的周期

Statistics.description_en:
The statistical method of the event-triggered task associated with the scaling rule. Valid values:

Average: the average value.
Maximum: the maximum value.
Minimum: the minimum value
Statistics.description_zh:
伸缩规则关联的报警任务的统计方式。可能值：

Average：统计平均值。
Maximum：统计最大值。
Minimum：统计最小值

Threshold.description_en: The alert threshold of the event-triggered task associated with the scaling rule
Threshold.description_zh: 伸缩规则关联的报警任务的报警阈值

Cooldown.description_en: The cooldown time of the scaling rule. This parameter applies only to simple scaling rules. Valid values: 0 to 86400. Unit: seconds
Cooldown.description_zh: 伸缩规则的冷却时间，仅适用于简单规则。 取值范围：0~86400，单位：秒

DisableScaleIn.description_en:
Specifies whether to disable scale-in. This parameter applies only to target tracking scaling rules. Valid values:

true: disables scale-in.
false: allows scale-in
DisableScaleIn.description_zh:
是否禁用缩容，仅适用于目标追踪规则。可能值：

true：禁用缩容。
false：允许缩容

EstimatedInstanceWarmup.description_en: The warmup time required for newly created instances to complete a series of preparations. During the warmup period, the started instances do not affect the monitoring metrics of the scaling group
EstimatedInstanceWarmup.description_zh: 新创建的实例做一系列准备措施，即预热所需要的时间，在预热时间内，已启动的实例将不影响伸缩组的监控指标

HybridMetrics.description_en: The monitoring metrics settings for Hybrid Cloud Monitoring. For more information about how to configure the settings, see [Use formula operations to customize target tracking scaling rules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852162.html）
HybridMetrics.description_zh: 企业云监控指标设置。如何设置，请参见[使用公式运算自定义目标追踪规则]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852162.html）

Dimensions.description_en: The dimensions of the metric. Used to specify the resources monitored by the metric
Dimensions.description_zh: 指标纬度。用于指定指标监控的资源

DimensionKey.description_en: The key of the metric dimension

DimensionValue.description_en: The value of the metric dimension

Expression.description_en:
The metric operation expression for multiple Hybrid Cloud Monitoring metrics. The calculation result of the expression is used to trigger scaling.

The operation expression must meet the Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) specification, and only the `+ - * /` operators are supported
Expression.description_zh:
多个企业云监控指标的公制运算表达式，表达式的计算结果将用于触发扩缩容。

运算表达式需满足逆波兰表达式（RPN）规范，并且操作符只支持`+ - * /`

Id.description_en: The reference ID of the metric in the metric operation expression
Id.description_zh: 公制运算表达式中指标的引用id

MetricName.description_en: The name of the monitoring metrics in the monitoring metrics repository for Hybrid Cloud Monitoring
MetricName.description_zh: 企业云监控指标仓库中的指标名称

Statistic.description_en:
The statistical method of the metric. Valid values:

Average: the average value of all data points in the specified period.
Minimum: the minimum value of all data points in the specified period.
Maximum: the maximum value of all data points in the specified period
Statistic.description_zh:
指标的统计方式。可能值：
Average：指定区间内所有点的平均值。
Minimum：指定区间内所有点的最小值。
Maximum：指定区间内所有点的最大值

HybridMonitorNamespace.description_en:
The ID of the monitoring metrics repository for Hybrid Cloud Monitoring.

To manage monitoring metrics repositories, see [Manage monitoring metrics repositories]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217606.html）
HybridMonitorNamespace.description_zh:
企业云监控指标仓库id。

管理指标仓库，请参见[管理指标仓库]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217606.html）

InitialMaxSize.description_en: The maximum number of instances in the scaling group. This parameter is used in combination with PredictiveValueBehavior
InitialMaxSize.description_zh: 伸缩组实例数的上限，和PredictiveValueBehavior结合使用

MaxSize.description_en: The maximum number of instances in the scaling group

MetricName.description_en: The name of the metric for the event-triggered task associated with the scaling rule
MetricName.description_zh: 伸缩规则关联的报警任务监控项名称

MetricType.description_en:
The type of the metric. Valid values:

system: uses system metrics of CloudMonitor.
custom: uses custom metrics reported to CloudMonitor.
hybrid: uses metrics of Hybrid Cloud Monitoring
MetricType.description_zh:
监控项类型。可能值：

system：使用云监控系统指标。
custom：使用上报到云监控的自定义指标。
hybrid：使用企业云监控的指标

MinAdjustmentMagnitude.description_en: The minimum number of instances to be adjusted by the scaling rule. This parameter takes effect only when the scaling rule type is SimpleScalingRule or StepScalingRule and the AdjustmentType is PercentChangeInCapacity
MinAdjustmentMagnitude.description_zh: 伸缩规则最小调整实例数，仅当伸缩规则类型为SimpleScalingRule或StepScalingRule，且AdjustmentType为PercentChangeInCapacity时生效

MinSize.description_en: The minimum number of instances in the scaling group

PredictiveScalingMode.description_en:
The mode of the predictive scaling rule. Valid values:

PredictAndScale: generates prediction results and creates predictive tasks.
PredictOnly: generates prediction results but does not create predictive tasks
PredictiveScalingMode.description_zh:
预测规则的模式。可能值：

PredictAndScale：产生预测结果并创建预测任务。
PredictOnly：产生预测结果，但不会创建预测任务

PredictiveTaskBufferTime.description_en: The predictive tasks automatically created by the predictive scaling rule are executed on the hour by default. You can set the pre-start time to execute the predictive tasks in advance and prepare resources. Valid values: 0 to 60. Unit: minutes
PredictiveTaskBufferTime.description_zh: 预测规则自动创建的预测任务默认均在整点执行，您可以设置预启动时间提前执行预测任务，预先准备资源。取值范围：0~60，单位：分钟

PredictiveValueBehavior.description_en:
The processing method for the maximum value of the predictive scaling rule. Valid values:

MaxOverridePredictiveValue: the initial maximum value overrides the predicted value. If the predicted value is greater than the initial maximum value, the maximum value of the predictive task uses the initial maximum value.
PredictiveValueOverrideMax: the predicted value overrides the initial maximum value. If the predicted value is greater than the initial maximum value, the maximum value of the predictive task uses the predicted value.
PredictiveValueOverrideMaxWithBuffer: a certain percentage is added to the predicted value. The predicted value is increased by the percentage specified by PredictiveValueBuffer. If the increased value is greater than the initial maximum value, the increased value is used
PredictiveValueBehavior.description_zh:
预测规则最大值处理方式。可能值：

MaxOverridePredictiveValue：初始最大值会覆盖预测值。预测值大于初始最大值时，预测任务的最大值采用初始最大值。
PredictiveValueOverrideMax：预测值会覆盖初始最大值。预测值大于初始最大值时， 预测任务的最大值采用预测值。
PredictiveValueOverrideMaxWithBuffer：预测值会附加一定比例。预测值会按照PredictiveValueBuffer比例增加，当增加后的值大于初始最大值时，会采用增加后的值

PredictiveValueBuffer.description_en: This parameter takes effect when PredictiveValueBehavior is set to PredictiveValueOverrideMaxWithBuffer. The predicted value is increased by this percentage. If the increased value is greater than the initial maximum value, the increased value is used. Valid values: 0 to 100
PredictiveValueBuffer.description_zh: PredictiveValueBehavior为PredictiveValueOverrideMaxWithBuffer时生效，预测值会按照该比例增加，当增加后的值大于初始最大值时，会采用增加后的值。取值范围：0~100

ScaleInEvaluationCount.description_en: After a target tracking scaling rule is created, an event-triggered task is automatically created. This parameter specifies the number of consecutive times the threshold condition must be met to trigger the scale-in event-triggered task
ScaleInEvaluationCount.description_zh: 创建目标追踪规则后，会自动创建报警任务。本参数用于指定对应的缩容报警任务触发报警时，所需连续满足阈值条件的次数

ScaleOutEvaluationCount.description_en: After a target tracking scaling rule is created, an event-triggered task is automatically created. This parameter specifies the number of consecutive times the threshold condition must be met to trigger the scale-out event-triggered task
ScaleOutEvaluationCount.description_zh: 创建目标追踪规则后，会自动创建报警任务。本参数用于指定对应的扩容报警任务触发报警时，所需连续满足阈值条件的次数

ScalingRuleName.description_en: The name of the scaling rule

The type of the scaling rule. Valid values:

ScalingRuleType.description_zh:
伸缩规则类型。可能值：

SimpleScalingRule：简单规则。根据调整方式（AdjustmentType）和调整值（AdjustmentValue）调整ECS实例数量。
TargetTrackingScalingRule：目标追踪规则。根据预定义监控（MetricName）项动态计算需要扩缩容的ECS实例数量，尽量将预定义监控项的指标值维持在目标值（TargetValue）附近。
StepScalingRule： 步进规则，根据阈值和指标值提供分步扩展方式。
PredictiveScalingRule：预测规则，基于机器学习能力分析伸缩组的历史监控数据预测未来监控指标值，并支持自动创建定时任务设置伸缩组边界

StepAdjustments.description_en: The step adjustments of the step scaling rule

items.description_en: The step adjustments of the step scaling rule

MetricIntervalLowerBound.description_en: The lower boundary of the step adjustment. Valid values: -9.999999E18 to 9.999999E18

MetricIntervalUpperBound.description_en: The upper boundary of the step adjustment. Valid values: -9.999999E18 to 9.999999E18

ScalingAdjustment.description_en: The number of instances to be scaled for the step adjustment
ScalingAdjustment.description_zh: 分步步骤对应的实例扩展数量

TargetValue.description_en: The target value. When the scaling rule is a target tracking scaling rule or a predictive scaling rule, the scaling rule maintains the metric near the target value by adding or removing instances
TargetValue.description_zh: 目标值。当伸缩规则为目标追踪规则或预测规则时，该伸缩规则将通过添加或删除实例来将指标维持在目标值附近

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of scaling rules
